mapping.summary: Compound cascade discounts, locked line prices and extended invoice discounts on sales and purchase documents.
claims: Enter cascade discounts like 10+5-2, resolved into the standard line discount percent
Cascade discounts work on sales lines, purchase lines and price list lines
Default cascade discount can be set on the customer card and proposed on new lines
Forced unit price or discount per line overrides the price list until cleared
Optionally carries agreed prices from blanket orders to orders and from orders to invoices
Invoice discount can come from payment terms plus a manual extra
Configurable reaction when one invoice combines orders with different invoice discounts
Cascade discount appears on e-invoices and printed documents
Covers quotes, blanket orders, orders, invoices, credit memos and returns
Needs BC 28.0 or later, online and on-premises
Available in English, Italian, Czech, Spanish and Polish
